strings.Проект выполнен в рамках разработки учеб: The project was carried out as part of the development of an educational and methodological complex for the program “Geodata and Geographic Information Systems”.
strings.Характеристика учебно-методического комп: Characteristics of the educational and methodological complex
strings.Учебно-методический комплекс (УМК) предн: The educational and methodological complex (UMK) is intended to support training courses and project work of students related to the analysis of the socioeconomic development of the Russian regions based on statistics and visual analytics. The educational complex provides a full cycle of “data → analysis → visualization → conclusions → recommendations” and includes:
strings.сводную базу социально-экономических пок: a consolidated database of socioeconomic indicators (85 Russian regions) with yearly dynamics;
strings.картографический слой субъектов РФ в фор: cartographic layer of the Russian regions in DataLens format (89 Russian regions);
strings.словарь показателей (описание переменных: Dictionary of indicators (description of variables, units of measurement, notes);
strings.методические рекомендации и практические: methodological recommendations and practical assignments for students.
strings.Уникальные особенности учебно-методическ: Unique features of the educational and methodological complex
strings.Ключевые особенности УМК:: Key features of the educational complex:
strings.комплексность (данные + геослой + словар: complexity (data + geolayer + dictionary of indicators + visualization);
strings.совместимость с ограничениями DataLens (: compatibility with DataLens limitations (formats, connections, performance);
strings.сравнимость регионов за счёт унификации: comparability of regions due to the unification of names;
strings.сценарная структура страниц как учебных: scenario structure of pages as educational analysis modules;
strings.развитие навыков работы с российским BI-: development of skills in working with Russian BI tools.
strings.Проектная часть: цель, задачи, описание,: Project part: goal, objectives, description, relevance, methods, results
strings.Цель — внедрение интерактивного дашборда: The goal is to introduce an interactive dashboard for training in the analysis of regional differences and the dynamics of socioeconomic indicators. Tasks included preparing the metrics database and vocabulary, preparing the geolayer (89 subjects), setting up connections, creating visualizations, and optimizing performance. The result is a ready-made dashboard and a package of tasks that allow you to use the product in lectures, practices and project-based learning.
strings.УМК может использоваться как цифровая ла: The educational complex can be used as a digital laboratory for regional analysis: forming hypotheses, testing on data, interpreting cartograms and time series, preparing management conclusions. Suitable for areas: economics, State Medical University, international relations, political science, business informatics/data analysis.

strings.Дашборд предоставляет интерактивный анал: The dashboard provides interactive analysis of territorial differences and dynamics of indicators. The user works through pages (thematic blocks) and selectors (region/set of regions, year/period, etc.). Typical scenario: KPI → map → graphs → tables.
